title.en: Denka, Anata ga Suteta Onna ga Honmono no Seijo desu
Ouji, Konyaku Haki Shita no wa Sochira na no de, Kowai Kao de Kocchi Niramanaide kudasai
Honmono no Seijo Janai to Bareta no ni, Outei Denka ni Semararete imasu
Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta
Konyaku Hakisareta "Kuuki" na Watashi, Nariagari no Danna-sama ni Totsugimashita.
Gimai ga Seijo dakara to Konyakuhaki Saremashita ga, Watashi wa Yousei no Itoshigo desu
Kono Ai wa, Kokuou Heika no Gomeirei Janai - Ohitori-sama Kibou no Reijou desu ga, Funaka na Kishi ga Hanashitekuremasen!
Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Toraretara Mishiranu Koushaku-sama ni Kyuukonsaremashita
Tsuihousareta Seijo desu ga, Douyara Watashi ga Honmono desu - Zense Kusushi wa "Iyashi" no Kusuri de Sukuitai!
Denka, Rien Zentei no Kekkon Seikatsu, Ika ga desu ka?
Seiryaku Kekkon no Otto ni "Aisanakute Kekkou desu" to Sengen Shitara Dekiai ga Hajimarimashita
Koi ni Koisuru Koushaku Reijou no Kojirase Renai
Konyaku Haki no Akui wa Shoukan Kara Okaeshi Shimasu
Ai ga Omome na Ookami Denka wa Unmei no Tsugai wo Nankin-chuu
Aru Hi, Mukuchi na Konyakusha no Kanjou ga Wakaru you ni narimashita
